question.problem:
A cinema has a rectangular hall whose dimensions are shown in the figure below. What is the area of the hall?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14195146/assets/e7263eb3d75ecb243301c2d6c5712dd77232b97b6839123febec3260b389b2e6.png)
question.worked_solution:
The area of a rectangle is given by 

$$
\mathcal{A} = a \cdot b,
$$

where $a$ and $b$ are the lengths of the sides.

From the figure, we obtain that 

$$
a = 4.5\,\mathrm{m}, \qquad b = 6\,\mathrm{m}.
$$

 

Therefore, the area of the hall is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =a\cdot b=4.5\cdot 6=27\,{\text{m}}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
